hypothesis: F0 action ranking can improve by predicting directly observed multi-horizon task measurements, rather than rolling out unreliable latent successors. Preserve factual history and all outcome/transition learning; protect the decision representation from auxiliary-head losses.

intervention.labels: Number of actually executed task transitions and collected items within each horizon, starting with the source action. Only mature windows or real terminal tails are labeled; unfinished budget tails remain masked.
intervention.learner: 3 zero-initialized dueling vector measurement heads on same64GRU; supervised smoothL1 with bootstrapped real-record masks. Core trained by measurement loss; old outcome/latent heads continue learning on detached core.
intervention.readout: Mean3 predictions of next64 steps/counts, clipped to physical bounds; .015*predicted steps + predicted pickups used only to choose action. No Q, rewardpacket, scalar-return optimization, TD bootstrap, imagined rollout, hidden truth, or extra capture penalty.
intervention.goal_change: 64step lookahead replaces old remaining-episode/deep prediction. Explicit finite-horizon method revision; not unchanged objective over arbitrarily delayed outcomes.
intervention.history: Original storage, retrieval features, all16legalactions, epsilon schedule remain. Root empirical additive removed, not historical features.
intervention.cost: Additional3measurement heads and supervised losses counted, not equal compute or attribution-only isolation.

comparisons: Same known4pairedseed oldF0 controls. Other3corearms shown from existing closed data on matchedfinal128scenes; no false fresh4-arm experiment claim. Report curves and perseed, not just finalmean.
stopping: One fixed candidate, no effect-driven tuning or extra seeds; firsterror/partial retained noautomaticretry. No old64seed restart.
limits: Direct future prediction is an existing approach; not claimed newly invented.
Purefeedback means no external scalarreward training/Q; it still has a publicgoal and numericpredictionloss.
Factual futures are policy-dependent, not causal answers for untried actions or guaranteed accurate counterfactuals.
Four known seeds are development evidence, not confirmation; 128/256nested evalepisodes are not independenttrainingN.
